             [--non-interactive] [--verbose]

One HASHI program, with isolated named instances.

positional arguments:
  {start,tui,status,stop,onboard,ui,help,version,doctor,logs,completion,instance}
    start               Start the selected instance in the background.
    tui                 Open the terminal UI for the selected instance.
    status              Show selected instance and live process state.
    stop                Gracefully stop an idle selected instance.
    onboard             Open local connection or Hashiko assistance.
    ui                  Open an installed external HASHI UI.
    help                Show this help.
    version             Show installed and selected runtime versions.
    doctor              Inspect installation and local health without changing
                        it.
    logs                Read sanitized instance runtime logs.
    completion          Print shell completion; profiles are not changed.
    instance            Manage isolated instances.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -i INSTANCE, --instance INSTANCE
                        Select an exact registered instance name. (default:
                        None)
  --json                Emit machine-readable output. (default: False)
  --lang {auto,zh,en}
  --no-color
  --non-interactive
  --verbose
